 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Dipenjan Chatterjee
 Mr. Kalyan Kumar Bhattacharjee
 Ms. Sahina Khatun
 Ms. Rimpa Adhikari
 ...

This revisional application has been filed challenging the proceeding in respect of Naihati Police Station Case No.67 of 2015 dated 6th February, 2015 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act corresponding to GR Case No.647 of 2015 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Barrackpore, North 24-Parganas.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Barrackpore, North 24-Parganas
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Perused the revisional application and the annexures thereto, I admit this revisional application.

3. The petitioners are directed to serve notice upon the opposite party no.2 by speed post with acknowledgement due and service to be made upon the State through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta, and file an affidavit of service to that effect on the returnable date.
4. Let the matter appear in the Combined Monthly List of January, 2024.
(Bibhas Ranjan De, J.)
